item.title: Telescope finds water vapour on a distant planet
item.description: Astronomers using the Orbiter telescope detected water vapour in the atmosphere of the planet K2-18c. The planet orbits a red dwarf star 120 light years away. The team published the result in a peer reviewed journal on Thursday.

item.title: University trial shortens battery charging
item.description: Researchers at Northfield University tested a new electrode coating in a lab trial. Cells with the coating reached 80 percent charge in 12 minutes. The coating has not yet been tested in full size batteries.
